exposure: Amniotic fluid lactate (AFL) levels at diagnosis of labor
cohort: 905 singleton, cephalic, term (≥37 weeks) nulliparous women in spontaneous labor
finding: Higher amniotic fluid lactate (AFL) levels at the diagnosis of labor are an independent predictor of labor disorders and cesarean delivery in term, nulliparous women.
mod_finding: AFL ≥10.0 mmol/L was an independent predictor of cesarean delivery.
birth_weight: Not significantly different based on labor disorder or delivery method
